rationale: Archive the erroneous SolarBank Joint Venture (New HoldCo) PortCo record and retract the CIM ownership period. The May 2025 transaction was a non-binding financing mandate, not an equity closing. PowerBank later disclosed that the preferred-equity/New HoldCo concept had been refocused to a proposed secured development loan to Abundant Solar Power, and definitive documents remained unexecuted. No legal New HoldCo identity, project transfer, CIM equity funding, debt funding, later close or signed pending ownership transaction was found through August 19, 2026. Preserve the chronology only as an archived financing concept; do not treat PowerBank, ASP or the underlying project pools as this PortCo.

afterImage.name: SolarBank Joint Venture (New HoldCo)
afterImage.description: Archived PortCo-census record for a contemplated SolarBank/PowerBank and CIM financing structure announced on May 6, 2025. The original non-binding mandate contemplated a newly formed holding company that could acquire interests in 21 U.S. renewable projects totaling approximately 97 MW and issue preferred equity to CIM, subject to definitive documents, project-level conditions and funding. PowerBank later disclosed that negotiations had been refocused toward a proposed secured development loan to its subsidiary Abundant Solar Power for 14 New York projects totaling approximately 48 MWdc, while the documents remained unexecuted. No legal name, jurisdiction, formation, project transfer, CIM equity investment, CIM loan funding, operating assets, employees, definitive closing or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 19, 2026. The record is archived because the proposed New HoldCo never became a verified operating company or direct CIM portfolio company; PowerBank, ASP and the underlying projects remain outside this placeholder record.

milestones.event: SolarBank and CIM announced a non-binding mandate for up to US$100 million; the contemplated New HoldCo, preferred equity and project transfers required future definitive documents and conditions.
The original prospective structure identified 21 U.S. projects totaling approximately 97 MW, but no project interests were transferred to CIM or a New HoldCo at announcement.
PowerBank's annual MD&A reported that definitive CIM documentation remained unexecuted and that no funding would occur without completed agreements.

PowerBank reported that negotiations had shifted from preferred equity/New HoldCo to a proposed secured development loan to ASP for 14 New York projects totaling approximately 48 MWdc; documents remained unexecuted.
A subsequent-event and exit search found no New HoldCo formation, project transfer, CIM funding, definitive closing or signed pending ownership transaction.
